about: Lorraine is a city on Montréal’s North Shore in Thérèse-De Blainville, a planned garden-city suburb between Bois-des-Filion and Rosemère—not those neighbours, and not Lorraine, France. Leafy residential streets, woodland parks, and a small civic core define this low-rise North Shore community. About 10,000 people live in Lorraine.
seoSummary: Planned North Shore garden-city between Bois-des-Filion and Rosemère—leafy suburb, not a big city.
